description_en: Query the details of multiple permission groups in a batch
description_zh: 批量查询权限组详细信息
name: ListAccessGroups

parameters.help_en:
The starting position of the query.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询起始位置。

默认值：1
parameters.name: start_offset

parameters.help_en:
The number of rows returned per page.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页返回结果的行数。

默认值：10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting return results.

Valid values:

CreateTime (default value): Sort by creation time.
AccessGroupName: Sort by permission group name
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果排序字段。

取值：

CreateTime（默认值）：按创建时间排序。
AccessGroupName：按权限组名称排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order for return results.

Valid values:

ASC (default value): Increment
DESC: Decrement
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果排序方式。

取值：

ASC（默认值）：递增
DESC：递减
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The next page identity.

If a query does not return all folders in one response, the NextToken returned is not empty. You can upload the correct NextToken in your query to continue retrieving results
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识。

如果一次查询结果并没有完整返回所有的目录，则返回 NextToken 不为空。您可以在查询中上传正确的 NextToken 继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

AccessGroups.description_en: A collection of permission group information

AccessGroupId.description_en: The ID of the permission group

AccessGroupName.description_en: The name of the permission group

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the permission group was created

Description.description_en: The description of the permission group

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the permission group is the default permission group for the user.

Valid values:

true: The permission group is the default permission group. When a permission group is set as the default, it allows access from all IP addresses, and the user cannot delete the default permission group or any permission rules within it.
false: The permission group is not the default permission group
IsDefault.description_zh:
权限组是否为用户的默认权限组。

包括：

true：该权限组为默认权限组。当该权限组为默认权限组时，允许所有IP地址访问，且用户无法删除默认权限组及权限组内的权限规则。
false：该权限组不是默认权限组

MountPointCount.description_en: The number of mount targets associated with the permission group
MountPointCount.description_zh: 权限组关联挂载点的数量

NetworkType.description_en: The type of the permission group

RuleCount.description_en: The number of permission rules in the permission group
RuleCount.description_zh: 权限组中权限规则的数量

NextToken.description_en:
The next page identity.

If a query does not return all folders in one response, the NextToken returned is not empty. You can upload the correct NextToken in your query to continue retrieving results
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页标识。

如果一次查询结果并没有完整返回所有的目录，则返回 NextToken 不为空。您可以在查询中上传正确的 NextToken 继续查询
